integrity_label: [INTEGRITY: WARN] historical/exploratory scope; no substantive numerical defect
intended_question: Does the positive relation-reconstruction signal persist across adjacent lambda values and multiple donors?
what_results_support: Two neighboring measured points, lambda0.1 and0.3, show positive donor-equal mean deltas against original_h and matched lambda0 MSE in this fixed historical protocol.
Lambda changes actual parameter updates and the reconstruction/geometric-proxy tradeoff; neural deltas and gradients are nonzero. The geometry proxy does not order classification performance.
The full seven-point grid is reported without selecting a winning lambda or changing the budget.
what_results_dont_support: A benefit shared by a majority of held-out donors: lambda0.1 and0.3 each improve only3/6 donors against original_h.
Robustness to removal of any one donor: each of lambda0.1 and0.3 has a six-exclusion range crossing0.
An independently confirmed improvement, a statistically significant or simultaneous confidence claim, a continuous favorable interval between tested points, or a recommended best lambda.
General SAE superiority, biological causality, unchanged gene attribution after dictionary updates, or convergence under the fixed1000-step budget.
missing_evidence: A new independent cohort or truly held-out donor set with a prespecified end-to-end lambda-selection rule.
More independent biological units and evidence that the benefit is not concentrated in a subset of donors.
suggested_claim_revision: 在历史探索性的 Kang 六供体数据、固定 τ=0.1 和相同追加1000步预算下，λ=0.1与0.3这两个相邻已测点的供体等权平均 Macro-F1 相对原始h分别提高0.2465和0.7213个百分点，相对配对MSE分别提高0.2927和0.7675个百分点；两点相对原始h均仅3/6供体改善。λ=0.1与0.3各自的六种删除单供体结果范围均跨0，因此证据只支持局部平均正信号，尚不支持跨供体稳定改善、连续有益参数区间或最佳λ。
future_options_if_separately_authorized: For a future confirmation study, freeze the complete selection rule before touching independent data; this review does not dispatch new training, temperature search or extra tuning.
confidence_scope: High confidence in the audited descriptive conclusion; generalization remains unestablished.
